domainStatus: The domain word is confirmed. The TLD has not been chosen and the domain has not been purchased, so no URL with a TLD may be published yet. This file is the only place the domain is recorded — do not repeat it in a manifest, a skill, a doc or the MCP server output.

offer.note: Prices, tier lists and the rendering policy live in licence.json at the repo root. Read them from there; do not restate them here.

local.note: Compositions render on the buyer's own machine with Remotion; there is no per-minute fee.

hosted.allowanceNote: The size of the hosted render allowance has not been decided, so no number is published anywhere. It is confirmed in the checkout receipt.
hosted.billingNote: Nothing is ever charged automatically. If the buyer wants more than the allowance, they choose it and they pay for it.
hosted.note: Studio can render on our machines. The MCP server never renders anything itself.
